stories.headline: Musk Unveils $20-25B TERAFAB Chip Factory as Tesla, SpaceX, xAI Joint Venture

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk announced TERAFAB on March 21 at Austin's Seaholm Power Plant — a $20-25 billion joint venture between Tesla, SpaceX, and xAI to build the largest chip manufacturing facility ever, targeting one terawatt of computing power annually.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla and SpaceX have unveiled 'Terafab,' a joint $25 billion chip fabrication facility in Austin, Texas, that Elon Musk claims will produce 1 terawatt of computing power annually. It would be the largest semiconductor fab ever built — by an absurd margin.

key_facts.fact: TERAFAB is targeting 2-nanometer process technology with initial output of 100,000 wafer starts per month, scaling to 1 million — roughly 70% of TSMC's entire current global output — and producing 100 to 200 billion custom AI chips per year.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla is targeting 2-nanometer process technology... The production targets are staggering. Terafab is designed for an initial output of 100,000 wafer starts per month, with ambitions to scale to 1 million wafer starts per month at full capacity. For context, that full-scale target would represent roughly 70% of TSMC's entire current global output.

key_facts.fact: Two chip types will be produced: the Tesla AI5 for vehicles and Optimus robots, and the D3 chip for space-based AI data centers. SpaceX filed an FCC application for up to one million AI data center satellites, each providing approximately 100 megawatts of computing capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX filed an FCC application in late January seeking approval for up to one million satellites dedicated to AI orbital data center applications.

key_facts.fact: Musk called it 'the most epic chip building exercise in history by far' and said 'We either build the Terafab or we don't have the chips, and we need the chips, so we're going to build the Terafab.' Production is expected to begin in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We either build the Terafab or we don't have the chips,' Musk said during the event. 'And we need the chips so we're going to build the Terafab.'

key_facts.fact: The facility will be built near Tesla's Giga Texas campus and will vertically integrate chip design, lithography, fabrication, memory production, advanced packaging, and testing — a capability no company outside legacy semiconductor firms currently possesses.
key_facts.excerpt: The $20 billion 'Terafab' plant will be built near Tesla's campus and gigafactory in eastern Travis County.

stories.headline: OpenAI Reveals Plan to Build Fully Autonomous AI Researcher by 2028, Intern by September

key_facts.fact: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki told MIT Technology Review that building a fully automated, agent-based AI researcher is now the company's 'North Star' for the next few years, pulling together work on reasoning models, agents, and interpretability.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI is refocusing its research efforts and throwing its resources into a new grand challenge... OpenAI says that this new research goal will be its 'North Star' for the next few years, pulling together multiple research strands, including work on reasoning models, agents, and interpretability.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI plans to build an 'autonomous AI research intern' — a system that can independently tackle a small number of specific research problems — by September 2026, as the precursor to a fully automated multi-agent research system debuting in 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki told MIT Technology Review that this project is now their long-term goal.

key_facts.fact: The system will independently plan its work, analyze information, and test different ideas across domains including mathematics, physics, biology, chemistry, and business — targeting problems too large or complex for humans to cope with.
key_facts.excerpt: The new AI system being developed will exceed basic prompt-response functionality. It will independently plan its work, analyze information, and test different ideas.

key_facts.fact: The full system will be a multi-agent architecture where multiple AI programs collaborate in data centers on larger projects. OpenAI is developing reasoning monitoring and restricted environments as safety measures for these long-running autonomous systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Scale into a multi-agent system where multiple AI programs collaborate in data centers on larger, more complex projects.

stories.headline: Cursor Admits Composer 2 Is Built on Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5, Sparking License Dispute

key_facts.fact: Cursor launched Composer 2 on March 19 as a proprietary frontier-level coding model, but developer @fynnso discovered the internal model ID 'kimi-k2p5-rl-0317-s515-fast' — revealing it was Kimi K2.5 with reinforcement learning applied.
key_facts.excerpt: A developer intercepted the API call and discovered the exact model ID: kimi-k2p5-rl-0317-s515-fast. The name reveals it: it's the Kimi K2.5 with reinforcement learning (RL) on top.

key_facts.fact: Moonshot AI's head of pretraining Yulun Du tested the tokenizer and confirmed it was 'completely identical to our Kimi tokenizer,' publicly questioning Cursor co-founder Michael Truell about licensing compliance before deleting his posts.
key_facts.excerpt: Moonshot AI's pretraining lead Du Yulun immediately tweeted that after testing Composer 2's tokenizer, they found it to be 'completely identical to our Kimi tokenizer,' and 'almost certain that this is our model further retrained.'

key_facts.fact: Cursor VP Lee Robinson confirmed: 'KIMI K2.5. Yes, that's the base we used,' claiming about one-quarter of compute came from the base model with the rest being Cursor's own training. The company asserts compliance through inference partner Fireworks.
key_facts.excerpt: Lee Robinson, VP of Developer Education at Cursor, openly confirmed: 'KIMI K2.5. Yes, that's the base we used.' According to him, only about 1/4 of the compute was from the base model, with the rest being their own training.

key_facts.fact: Kimi K2.5's Modified MIT license requires commercial products with over $20 million in monthly revenue or over 100 million users to prominently display 'Kimi K2.5' in the interface — a threshold Cursor, valued at $29.3 billion and seeking a $50 billion valuation, almost certainly triggers.
key_facts.excerpt: Kimi K2.5 uses a modified MIT license, explicitly stating that commercial products with over 100 million active users or over $20 million in monthly revenue must prominently display 'Kimi K2.5' in the user interface.

key_facts.fact: Kimi K2.5 is a 1 trillion parameter model trained with 15 trillion tokens, developed by Beijing-based Moonshot AI (backed by Alibaba and HongShan). The controversy has fueled debate about whether AI coding startups built on VS Code forks and open-source models justify billion-dollar valuations.
key_facts.excerpt: The Kimi K2.5 is a 1 trillion parameter model trained with 15 trillion tokens. Moonshot made it open to foster the ecosystem. Meanwhile, discussions are blowing up on Hacker News and Reddit.

stories.headline: Tencent Integrates OpenClaw AI Agent into WeChat, Reaching 1 Billion+ Users

key_facts.fact: Tencent launched ClawBot on March 22 to integrate the OpenClaw AI agent with WeChat, China's most popular messaging app with over 1 billion monthly active users, allowing them to send and receive commands through the chat interface.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent launched a tool on March 22 to integrate its WeChat messaging platform with the OpenClaw agent, deepening its push into artificial intelligence agents that have become a key battleground among China's technology companies.

key_facts.fact: ClawBot appears as a contact within WeChat, enabling users to interact with OpenClaw — an open-source AI agent created by Peter Steinberger that can perform tasks such as transferring files, sending emails, browsing the web, and initiating transactions on users' behalf.
key_facts.excerpt: The software, called ClawBot, will appear as a contact within WeChat, allowing users of China's most popular app with more than one billion monthly active users to connect directly with OpenClaw.

key_facts.fact: The integration follows Tencent's earlier March launch of its own AI agent suite — QClaw for individuals, Lighthouse for developers, and WorkBuddy for enterprises — as Chinese tech giants race to dominate the AI agent market.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent's WeChat integration follows the company's launch earlier in March of its own AI agent suite, comprising QClaw for individual users, Lighthouse for developers and WorkBuddy for enterprises.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba launched Wukong last week (an enterprise AI platform coordinating multiple agents for document editing and meeting transcription), while Baidu followed with AI agents built on OpenClaw spanning desktop software, further intensifying China's AI agent race.
key_facts.excerpt: Last week, Alibaba launched Wukong, an artificial intelligence platform for enterprises that coordinates multiple AI agents to handle complex business tasks including document editing and meeting transcription within a single interface.

stories.headline: OpenAI Plans to Nearly Double Workforce to 8,000 by Year-End to Counter Anthropic

key_facts.fact: The Financial Times reported on Saturday March 21 that OpenAI plans to nearly double its workforce from 4,500 to 8,000 employees by end of 2026, citing two people with knowledge of the matter. Most hires will be in product development, engineering, research, and sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Artificial intelligence start-up OpenAI plans to nearly double its workforce to 8,000 from 4,500 by the end of 2026, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing two people with knowledge of the matter.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is also recruiting specialists for 'technical ambassadorship' roles aimed at helping businesses implement its AI tools more effectively, reflecting an enterprise sales push.
key_facts.excerpt: The ChatGPT-maker is also ramping up recruitment of specialists focused on 'technical ambassadorship,' aimed at helping businesses make better use of its tools, the report added.

key_facts.fact: The hiring push follows CEO Sam Altman's internal 'code red' declared in early December, which paused non-core projects and redirected teams to accelerate development in response to Google's Gemini 3 launch.
key_facts.excerpt: This aggressive expansion follows CEO Sam Altman's internal 'code red' declaration last December, which paused non-core projects and redirected resources toward competitive development. The emergency measure came in direct response to Google's Gemini 3 launch.

key_facts.fact: Businesses are now 70% more likely to choose Anthropic over OpenAI when buying AI services for the first time, according to Ramp's AI Index, underscoring the competitive pressure driving the expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: According to the AI Index from Ramp, a fintech startup that manages corporate expenses, businesses are now 70 percent more likely to go with Anthropic when buying AI services for the first time as opposed to OpenAI.

stories.headline: Dexterity's Foresight World Model Hits 17x Speedup on Nvidia, Enabling Sub-400ms Robotics

key_facts.fact: Dexterity.ai detailed how its Foresight world model achieved a 17x speedup (from 1,508ms to 90ms per cycle) on Nvidia L4 GPUs with TensorRT optimization, enabling decision cycles under 400ms for complex industrial robotics tasks.
key_facts.excerpt: The redesigned perception pipeline delivered a 17x speedup (from 1,508 ms to 90 ms per cycle).

key_facts.fact: The redesigned pipeline now processes all available sensor data rather than just 3%, a 32x increase in data utilization per cycle that enables 'far richer understanding of every scene' for autonomous manipulation.
key_facts.excerpt: The system now processes all available sensor data rather than just 3 percent — a 32x increase in data utilization per cycle, enabling 'far richer understanding of every scene.'

key_facts.fact: CEO Samir Menon said 'Physical AI has been a research topic for decades. What's changed is that it now works extremely well in production.' The system is deployed in real customer environments including autonomous trailer loading for FedEx using a dual-armed Mech robot.
key_facts.excerpt: According to CEO Samir Menon, 'Physical AI has been a research topic for decades. What's changed is that it now works extremely well in production.'

stories.headline: Edra Exits Stealth with $30M Sequoia-Led Round for AI Workflow Automation

key_facts.fact: Edra, a New York-based AI workflow automation startup, emerged from stealth with a $30 million Series A led by Sequoia Capital, with participation from 8VC, A* (Kevin Hartz's venture firm), and HubSpot Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Edra, a New York-based workflow automation startup, has raised $30 million in a Series A funding round led by Sequoia Capital, marking its emergence from stealth mode.

key_facts.fact: Founded by CEO Eugen Alpeza and CTO Yannis Karamanlakis, both former Palantir engineers who spent several years there — Alpeza led major client acquisition and the launch of Palantir's AI platform, while Karamanlakis served as a company AI architect.
key_facts.excerpt: The company was founded by CEO Eugen Alpeza and CTO Yannis Karamanlakis, who met at university 13 years ago and spent several years at Palantir Technologies. Alpeza led major commercial client acquisition and the launch of Palantir's AI platform.

key_facts.fact: Total funding exceeds $30 million including an earlier seed round of approximately $6.5 million co-led by 8VC and A*, signaling strong investor confidence in agentic workflow automation for enterprises.
key_facts.excerpt: This brings Edra's total funding to more than $30 million, following an earlier seed round of approximately $6.5 million co-led by 8VC and A*, with HubSpot Ventures also participating in both rounds.
